summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ADT Operations feature. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all ADT operation forms (Admission, Transfer, Discharge, Update) and Settings modal Operation Types tab are functional.

backend: POST /api/adt/admission - Admits patient with HL7 ADT^A01 message
POST /api/adt/transfer - Transfers patient to regular room with HL7 ADT^A02
POST /api/adt/transfer - Transfers patient to unknown location
POST /api/adt/transfer - Transfers patient to OR room
POST /api/adt/discharge - Immediate discharge with HL7 ADT^A03
POST /api/adt/discharge - Scheduled discharge creates scheduled message
Error handling - Patient not found returns 404
Error handling - Invalid operation type returns 404
frontend: Login page loads and authentication works
ADT Operations page navigation via sidebar
Tenant selection shows tenants for selected environment (Mayo Clinic, Reid health)
Operation selection buttons (Admission, Update, Transfer, Discharge)
Admission form - MRN, CSN, patient info, bed definition fields
Admission form - Submit button enabled when required fields filled
Transfer form - Patient search and selection
Transfer form - Patient list shows admitted patients
Discharge form - Patient search and selection
Update form - Patient search and operation type selection
Settings modal opens from header button
Settings modal - Operation Types tab accessible
Settings modal - Operation Types CRUD form works
Settings modal - Shows 6 default operation types (ORM, ORU, Medications, etc.)
Settings modal - Create new operation type works

seed_data_creation: Test patients created with MRN prefix 'TEST_' during backend tests. Operation types seeded via /api/seed-operation-types endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ADT Operations feature is fully functional. Backend Node.js server running on port 8001. All ADT endpoints (admission, transfer, discharge, update) generate HL7 messages and store patient data in MongoDB. Operation types are configurable via Settings modal. External HL7 endpoints may timeout (expected behavior). DEV environment has Mayo Clinic and Reid health tenants.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - No critical issues found. ADT Operations feature is complete and functional.
